caption: The drawing depicts a piece of wooden furniture consisting of a rectangular table-like top supported by two vertical side panels and a rear panel, creating an open shelf beneath the tabletop. Below the open shelf, there are two large drawers stacked vertically, each occupying the full width of the unit. The drawers have metal pull handles, one on each drawer, positioned in the center. The wood displays a natural grain pattern with shades of light brown and beige, and the overall structure is rendered with clear lines and shading to indicate depth. The background is an off-white or light tan color, and the furniture occupies the central area of the composition. There is handwritten text in the lower right-hand corner.
title: Seat Table
